nodes.label: AI Knowledge Assistant v2
nodes.tooltip: Earlier Python prototype — LLM + RAG + SQL · LangChain
nodes.details:
AI Knowledge Assistant with RAG

View on GitHub →

Project: slm-assistant-v2 · Generative AI + Business Intelligence · 2026

Built an enterprise knowledge assistant combining Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and SQL-based business data access. Users ask questions in natural language and receive answers from both company documentation and live operational data.

  • Architecture: Python, FastAPI, LangChain orchestration
  • Knowledge Base: Document embeddings in vector database (Pinecone/Weaviate); structured data in PostgreSQL
  • Intelligent Routing: LangChain determines retrieval from vector DB (documents), SQL DB (metrics), or both
  • Semantic Retrieval: Embedding-based similarity search for document-based queries
  • SQL Generation & Validation: Automated SQL query generation with validation and security checks
  • Prompt Engineering: Context-aware, grounded responses with optimised prompts
  • Production Features: Query validation, response monitoring, latency optimisation, security hardening
  • Skills Applied: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, embeddings, prompt engineering, vector databases, SQL, AI system design

nodes.label: AI Knowledge Assistant v3 (RAG)
nodes.tooltip: NestJS · Next.js · LangChain · Chroma · multi-provider LLM
nodes.details:
SLM Assistant v3 — Multi-Tenant RAG Assistant

View on GitHub →

2026 · A from-scratch TypeScript rewrite of the v2 Python prototype: users sign in with Google, upload documents and chat with an LLM that answers from retrieved context. Admins control which LLM providers are available.

  • Stack: Turborepo monorepo, NestJS + Prisma, Next.js 16 / React 19 / Tailwind 4, PostgreSQL, Chroma, Redis
  • RAG: structure-aware chunking with per-document chunk caps for retrieval diversity; custom LangChain BaseRetriever over Chroma and an LCEL generation chain
  • Multi-provider: three model providers (Groq open-weight, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) switchable at runtime; embeddings computed locally with Hugging Face Transformers
  • Security: Google OAuth2 + JWT httpOnly cookie, RBAC, AES-256-GCM encrypted provider API keys at rest
  • Performance: Redis FAQ answer cache with frequency ranking, version-counter cache invalidation, provider rate-limit header tracking
  • Speech service: Python FastAPI + faster-whisper (CTranslate2, int8, CPU) with BullMQ background processing — retries, backoff and permanent-failure handling

nodes.label: Clinic AI — Decision Support
nodes.tooltip: FastAPI · React · Azure OpenAI · deterministic safety checks
nodes.details:
Clinic AI — Clinical Decision-Support Assistant

View on GitHub →

2026 · The doctor types a complaint and exam findings; the AI asks for missing information or drafts likely conditions and 2–3 medicines. The doctor reviews, edits and approves, and the app issues a digitally signed PDF prescription. The AI drafts, the doctor decides.

  • Stack: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, React + TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose
  • LLM drafting: medicine suggestions restricted to the clinic formulary; Azure OpenAI primary with Groq fallback
  • Deterministic safety rules: allergies, pregnancy, age and drug interactions checked in plain code, not by the AI
  • Agent: read-only tool-calling assistant with a hand-written agent loop
  • Privacy & security: de-identified model calls, Google OAuth with doctor allowlist, audit logging
  • Prescriptions: HMAC-signed PDFs with QR verification
  • Quality: 200+ automated tests in GitHub Actions on every push and every 6 hours, with automatic failure alerts

nodes.label: DocScan AI — Document Analysis

nodes.details:
DocScan AI — Document Analysis Application

View on GitHub →

2026 · Upload a resume and receive an AI-generated score, summary, extracted skills and concrete improvement suggestions through a designed interface.

  • Pipeline: file upload → Azure AI Document Intelligence (OCR) → Azure OpenAI (scoring, summary, suggestions) → PostgreSQL persistence → Azure Blob Storage backup
  • Stack: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, React (Vite), PostgreSQL
  • Auth: JWT (OAuth2 password flow) and Google Sign-In, bcrypt password hashing, admin user management
  • Infra: containerised with Docker Compose (Postgres + backend + nginx-served frontend)

nodes.label: DropshipAI — Multi-Tenant SaaS
nodes.tooltip: FastAPI · Postgres RLS · Celery · Shopify / eBay · PayPal
nodes.details:
DropshipAI — Multi-Channel Listing & Inventory Sync

View on GitHub →

2026 · A multi-tenant SaaS where a seller creates one product listing and publishes it, AI-optimised per platform, to Shopify, eBay and their own website — with stock synced across every channel whenever a sale happens.

  • Stack: FastAPI, PostgreSQL with Alembic, Celery + Redis, Docker Compose
  • Tenant isolation: shared database with two layers — a scoped-query guard in app code and Postgres Row-Level Security policies
  • AI listing enrichment: Azure OpenAI output validated against Pydantic schemas, falling back to seller text if invalid
  • Channel adapters: common interface with Shopify and eBay implementations, extensible to new marketplaces
  • Stock sync: webhooks as primary path, 5-minute Celery poll as backup; nightly reorder alerts from sales-velocity math
  • Billing & security: PayPal Subscriptions with plan-based channel limits, Google OAuth, Fernet-encrypted channel credentials
